verdicts.text: Ensemble of 5 wins the walk-forward exam: +6.46% on unseen 2025 vs −6.54% single-seed, with lower drawdown and fewer trades — the variance-reduction signature
Vector memory retired: a plain logistic fit extracts 3× more from the same features (edge +0.061 vs +0.022)
Deep-field net: first candidate ever to win the held-out half — and sealed 2026 said −18.04%. Splits cannot police a net that trained inside them
Walk-forward A/B: blind 15-bar net beats the seeing 127-bar net on unseen 2025 — short reach is a structural regulariser
